caption: Signup profile screen headed "You've Been Upgraded to a Premium Free Trial!": 14 days on the top plan, then a profile form (company, industry, size, landing page experience) before you can build; the name fields are hidden.
Create New Page with "Build your page instantly with AI": our prompt asks for two sections of test text, "TEST Zoë Alpha" and "TEST Bèta Twee", with accents and quotes.

The page the AI builder made from that prompt: headings "TEST Zoë Alpha" and "TEST Bèta Twee" and the test lines appear exactly as written, accents and quotes included, and the Unbounce AI panel says so.
All Pages after saving: the test page is marked Unpublished, the trial banner says 13 days left on the signup day and the traffic meter reads 0/500; the account name and avatar are hidden.
The page menu offers Edit, Preview, Duplicate, Groups, Copy to a Client and Delete, but no page download or export; the account name and avatar are hidden.
Edit Code shows the full HTML and CSS of the unpublished page, including a robots meta tag set to "index,follow"; it can be copied out, but there is no download.
